sources.name: FirstRand Bank EFT terms of use (unpaid and dispute reason codes)

entries.subject: unpaid_code_02
entries.display: Code 02 = Not provided for, meaning insufficient funds
entries.quote: 02 Not provided for There are insufficient funds in the bank account.
entries.notes: Allowed set of descriptions in Appendix A: 02 Not provided for; 03 No Debit / Credit transactions allowed; 04 Payment stopped; 06 Account frozen; 08 Account in sequestration; 10 Account in liquidation; 12 Account closed; 14/16 Account transferred; 18 Accountholder deceased; 22 Account effects not cleared; 26 No such account; 56 Not FICA compliant; 31/33 credit returns.

entries.subject: unpaid_code_03
entries.display: Code 03 = no debit or credit transactions allowed on the account
entries.quote: 03 No Debit / Credit transactions allowed against this account No debit or credit payment instructions may be processed against this bank account.
entries.notes: A new mandate with different bank details is required.

entries.subject: unpaid_code_12
entries.quote: 12 Account closed The bank account in question has been closed.
entries.notes: Current and all future instructions must be removed.

entries.subject: unpaid_code_26
entries.display: Code 26 = no such account at the specified bank
entries.quote: 26 No such account The bank account does not exist at the specified Bank.

entries.subject: unpaid_code_56
entries.display: Code 56 = account does not comply with FICA
entries.quote: 56 Not FICA compliant The bank account does not comply with the requirements as set out by FICA.
entries.notes: Resubmit only once the accountholder confirms FICA compliance.

entries.subject: dispute_code_30
entries.display: Code 30 = no authority to debit (accountholder disputes the mandate)
entries.quote: 30 No authority to debit The accountholder has disputed the User’s authority to debit funds from their bank account.
entries.notes: A new mandate is required before any further collection.

entries.subject: credit_return_window
entries.display: Unidentified credit payments must be returned within 40 calendar days of the effective transaction date
entries.quote: The transactions must be returned within 40 calendar days from the effective transaction date.
entries.notes: Applies to codes 31 and 33 (unrecognised initiating party / non-unique reference).

entries.subject: unpaid_ratio_threshold
entries.display: Originators must keep unpaids at or below 10% of monthly instructions
entries.quote: The User is obligated to adhere to the thresholds of 10% for Unpaid Ratio and 0.5% for Dispute Ratio of total monthly payment instructions processed per abbreviated name.
entries.notes: Corroborated by Netcash and Standard Bank, both citing the 10% unpaid / 0.5% dispute PASA ratios.

entries.subject: dispute_ratio_threshold
entries.display: Disputes must stay at or below 0.5% of monthly instructions
entries.quote: The User is obligated to adhere to the thresholds of 10% for Unpaid Ratio and 0.5% for Dispute Ratio of total monthly payment instructions processed per abbreviated name.
entries.notes: Also stated by Netcash and Standard Bank.

entries.subject: unpaid_code_60
entries.display: Code 60 = rejected debit, blocked account that is no longer sent to the bank
entries.quote: Rejected debits – consecutively unpaid and no longer submitted to the bank (Code 60).
entries.notes: Unblocked only by submitting a new mandate to the collecting party.

entries.subject: presentment_limit_per_cycle
entries.display: At most two presentments of the same payment instruction per payment cycle
entries.quote: Present more than 2 (two) Payment Instructions in any Payment Cycle.
entries.notes: Stated as a prohibition ('A Netcash client may not').

entries.subject: not_provided_for_retry_rule
entries.display: After two consecutive 'not provided for' returns the instruction must be removed
entries.quote: When a Payment Instruction is returned “Not Provided for” on 2 (two) consecutive mandated Action Dates, the User may not submit the Payment Instruction and must remove the Payment Instruction from the system unless the User has received a new Mandate from the Payer to meet future payments.
entries.notes: Corroborated by FNB clause 7.4 (code 02 for two consecutive payment cycles) and Standard Bank's unpaids section. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

notes: Codes are those published by FirstRand Bank for EFT debit collections (Appendix A), with the Netcash blocked-account code 60 and presentment rules. RTC has no published decline-code table in this corpus, so no RTC failure codes are asserted.
